nodes.title: POS Remote Request
nodes.summary: The POS Remote Request suite of APIs allows you to remotely invoke a payment on a POS terminal and requery for the status of the transaction.

nodes.title: Create Payment Request
nodes.summary: This endpoint enables you to send a payment request to a POS terminal, which then receives and processes the card payment.

nodes.title: POST /softpos/pos/remote-request
nodes.summary: This endpoint allows you to send a payment request to a POS terminal.

nodes.title: Parameters
nodes.summary: This section details the required header and body parameters for creating a payment request, including authorization, terminal ID, amount, and account type.

nodes.title: Sample POS Remote Request
nodes.summary: This section provides a sample JSON body for a POS remote payment request, illustrating the terminal ID, amount, and account type.

nodes.title: Responses
nodes.summary: This section outlines the possible API responses for creating a payment request, including successful, validation error, and invalid token scenarios.

nodes.title: Requery Payment Status
nodes.summary: This endpoint allows you to requery the terminal using the request reference to confirm if payment is completed or not.

nodes.title: GET /softpos/pos/remote-request/{request_ref}
nodes.summary: This endpoint allows you to requery the status of a specific payment request using its reference.

nodes.title: Parameters
nodes.summary: This section outlines the required header (Authorization) and path (request_ref) parameters for requerying payment status.

nodes.title: Sample Request
nodes.summary: This section provides a sample GET request URL demonstrating how to query payment status using a request reference.

nodes.title: Responses
nodes.summary: This section details various API responses for requerying payment status, including successful, pending, failed, expired/not found, and invalid token outcomes, along with specific handling for expired requests.

nodes.title: POS Webhook
nodes.summary: This section explains how POS merchants can configure their Squad Dashboard to receive webhook notifications directly from their terminals for successful payments.

nodes.title: Sample webhook for webhook notifications (From POS to merchant system)
nodes.summary: This section presents a sample JSON payload for webhook notifications sent from a POS terminal to a merchant system upon successful payment.
